Fezandipiti's attempts at progress with Toxic Chain are seldom punished, as the only defensive Steel-type is the uncommon Ferrothorn, and Eternatus is unable to meaningfully harm Fezandipiti. Consequently, Fezandipiti often has free reign to utilize its support movepool to help provide teammates with optimal entry points. For example, on many balance teams, Ho-Oh is the best switch-in to Fezandipiti, so using Acid Spray and then pivoting out provides Fezandipiti two opportunities to trigger Toxic Chain while also enabling special attacking teammates to break it without the need to set up. Fezandipiti is excellent against stall, as only Ho-Oh's Brave Bird threatens it. Although Fezandipiti technically counters stall, its value stems from its from its ability to position its teammates to make progress while passively spreading Toxic poison. Although stall structures don't threaten Fezandipiti, it will run out of PP without teammates such as Taunt Arceus formes to help preserve progress.

  • While Fezandipiti is remarkably consistent in performing its defensive duties, it is not a Pokemon that should be haphazardly tossed onto teams while ignoring its flaws—namely its poor Defense and inability to directly beat most physical attackers. Consequently, Coil Zygarde is an excellent partner, as it can blanket check most of the physical metagame. Zygarde's Tera type is flexible between Fairy and Water, but it should be tailored based on whether the team is weaker to Dragon Dance Zygarde or Dragon Dance Necrozma-DM, respectively. In return, Fezandipiti counters most of the special attackers that threaten Zygarde such as Yveltal and Taunt Arceus formes. Calm Mind Arceus-Dark is the preferred Arceus partner of choice, as it counters Ultra Necrozma, helps to maintain progress with Taunt, and is a wincon that is effective against bulkier structures. Fezandipiti facilitating the easy removal of Sticky Web furthers Arceus-Dark's reach, as it is able to further counter specially offensive Yveltal as well as check Chi-Yu once the hazard is removed. Additionally, it serves as a soft check to Dragon Dance Necrozma-DM, the only offensive Pokemon unbothered by Fezandipiti.

  • Defensive Primal Groudon makes an excellent teammate, since it can provide hazard support while checking Zacian-C and Primal Kyogre defensively. In turn, Primal Groudon appreciates Fezandipiti's ability to counter specially offensive Yveltal. This enables Primal Groudon to more easily fit in Spikes over Stealth Rock, as Yveltal is the main target of Stealth Rock, although Stealth Rock is still useful on teams weak to Rayquaza.

  • While neither Fezandipiti itself nor the structures it fits on are particularly weak to hazards, removal is always appreciated. Consequently, offensive Ho-Oh is an excellent partner, as it is offensively threatening in its own right while providing additional support in the form of phazing or Thunder Wave. Ho-Oh greatly appreciates Fezandipiti's Icy Wind and pivot support, enabling it to easily remove hazards against most offensive structures and ability to handle Pokemon such as Meteor Beam Eternatus. Additionally, with Tera Grass Ho-Oh can help check Ground-types such as Zygarde and Arceus-Ground, which threaten Fezandipiti. On bulkier balances Giratina-O is an option alongside Pokemon such as Alomomola and Landorus-T to provide a more pivot-heavy playstyle to enable frailer Pokemon such as Chien-Pao or Deoxys-A.

  • Fezandipiti's pivoting support enables it to facilitate safe entry for many frail wallbreakers. This is most appreciated by Deoxys-A, which heavily punishes Pokemon that Terastallize into Poison-types in an attempt to nullify Toxic Chain such as Arceus formes and Giratina-O. Deoxys-A's high Speed also provides the team with speed control and an easy means to revenge kill Terastallized Zacian-C. Tera Ghost is usually preferred on Deoxys-A to help with Extreme Killer Arceus. Fezandipiti also synergizes well with mid-Speed wallbreakers such as Primal Kyogre and Rayquaza, as they are able to outspeed the entire unboosted metagame bar Deoxys-S after Icy Wind.

monotype.overview:
Fairy

Fezandipiti can serve a very nice defensive role on Fairy thanks to it being the only Fairy-type Pokemon with access to both a pivoting move and a reliable form of recovery, along with its ability to take on the Ogerpon formes and absorb Toxic Spikes. However, unlike most of Fairy's defensive setpieces, Fezandipiti struggles to pressure Steel- and Poison-types like Scizor and Pecharunt that can exploit it to set up.

Bulky Pivot (Fairy).description:
Fezandipiti finds a spot on Fairy teams thanks to its Poison typing, access to U-turn, and solid special bulk enabling it to comfortably take hits from the likes of Choice Specs Dragapult and Raging Bolt while bringing in teammates. Beat Up pairs well with Toxic Chain, enabling Fezandipiti to reliably spread poison onto switch-ins like Hippowdon and Moltres along with checking Ceruledge. Gunk Shot enables Fezandipiti to handle Grass- and Fairy-types like the Ogerpon formes, Meowscarada, and Flutter Mane. The EV spread enables Fezandipiti to survive a weather-boosted Ivy Cudgel from the Ogerpon formes and OHKO them back with Gunk Shot, with the Speed IVs bettering its slow pivoting while still allowing it to outspeed Jolly Azumarill.

Flutter Mane greatly appreciates Fezandipiti handling opposing Flutter Mane and providing safe entry; in return, it can remove threats like Choice Specs Greninja, Gholdengo, and Hatterene along with checking the likes of Toxapex and Skarmory with coverage moves such as Thunderbolt. Iron Valiant similarly appreciates the safe entry Fezandipiti provides and can handle Steel-types such as Hisuian Goodra and Heatran as well as take care of Ground-types like Clodsire and non-Choice Scarf Landorus with Ice Punch. Azumarill and Primarina value Fezandipiti's ability to check Grass-types like Meowscarada and Rillaboom with Gunk Shot and in return can take on Fire- and Ground-types such as Iron Moth, Moltres, and Gliscor. Hatterene can support Fezandipiti by taking care of Poison-types that effortlessly take Gunk Shot like Toxapex and Okidogi with Psyshock; Magic Bounce also prevents Will-O-Wisp from the likes of Galarian Weezing and Sableye from crippling Fezandipiti. Klefki can set Spikes to wear down checks like Swampert and Archaludon as well as check the likes of Scizor and Iron Boulder with Foul Play. Enamorus provides a helpful Ground immunity along with breaking Steel- and Poison-types such as Archaludon, Bisharp, and Pecharunt with coverage options like Earth Power.

Defensive.description: 64 Speed EVs allow Fezandipiti to outspeed Adamant Tapu Bulu and 100 Special Attack EVs guarantee an OHKO on physically defensive Tapu Bulu with Sludge Bomb.

vgc2024.overview:
• Ogerpon is a strong offensive Pokemon that is unique in being able to check many top Pokemon such as Incineroar and Flutter Mane thanks to its ability Defiant and Speed-boosting Embody Aspect after Terastallization. Combined with access to Follow Me and natural immunity to Spore, Ogerpon is capable of being a constant threat while still providing good supportive value.

  • Ogerpon is almost exclusively used on teams built around Dondozo. With its ability Defiant, Ogerpon can be used to punish Incineroar and Gouging Fire, disincentivizing them from weakening both Dondozo and Chien-Pao and even picking up a clean OHKO on Incineroar with Superpower. Once Terastallized, It can outspeed and OHKO Flutter Mane and both Urshifu formes, which are difficult for Dondozo and Chien-pao or Dragonite to handle.

  • Ogerpon struggles against Pokemon that resist Grass STAB as Tornadus and Raging Bolt as well as foes that outspeed it, either forcing Ogerpon to Terastallize or be unable to attack before fainting, such as Chien-Pao, which outspeeds and can survive one hit thanks to it usually holding a Focus Sash. Ogerpon's Grass typing means it's weak to common threats such as Chien-Pao and Gouging Fire, and its middling bulk makes it unable to take more than two attacks most of the time.

Offensive Redirector.description:
• Superpower is used as coverage to hit Steel- and the plethora of Dark-types that resist Ivy Cudgel, such as Kingambit or Chi-yu. Follow Me can be used to redirect attention from the frailer Chien-Pao and Glimmora, making both exponentially harder to deal with, especially so considering Ogerpon resists Urshifu-R Surging Strike's, one of the best counters to Chien-Pao and Glimmora

  • Covert Cloak is used to prevent a flinch from Fake Out, allowing Ogerpon to pressure Incineroar and its partner turn one. Additionally, blocking certain secondary effects such as Icy Wind's Speed drops from opposing Flutter Manes is useful.

  • The Attack investment is necessary to guarantee an OHKO on Incineroar with Superpower, on Flutter Mane once Ogerpon Terastallizes, and to have the highest chance of an OHKO on Urshifu-R. The Speed investment allows Ogerpon to outspeed Choice Scarf Landorus-T after Terastallization. The rest of the EVs are used to round out Ogerpon's bulk.

Pivot.description:
Ogerpon functions as a solid pivot within the tier thanks to an array of excellent utility moves, a powerful STAB move in Ivy Cudgel, and great offensive stats. Knock Off allows Ogerpon to punish many of the Pokemon attempting to switch into it such as Heatran, Tornadus-T, and Skeledirge. U-turn allows Ogerpon to pivot out of matchups that are unfavorable for it such as Tinkaton, Cobalion, and Skeledirge while doing solid damage to Hydrapple that may want to switch in, and thanks to Heavy-Duty Boots, it is able to remain healthy throughout the match and easily pivot in and out of the field. Encore gives it the ability to take advantage of slower Pokemon that have locked themselves into an awkward move so it can go for a free move the turn after, such as Skarmory using Roost or Mandibuzz clicking Defog, which, when paired with Defiant, gives Ogerpon a free Attack boost. On the other hand, Ogerpon is able to use the pressure it creates as opportunities to set up Spikes for its team, helping its teammates and itself by slowly chipping down the opposing team's checks. Ogerpon's Tera type is locked into Grass, but with Embody Aspect, it is given a boost to its Speed on top of the additional boost to its STAB moves, letting it OHKO Slowking and have a chance to 2HKO Tornadus-T after Stealth Rock. This means that Ogerpon can act not only as a powerful breaker with Tera, but also as an emergency speed control option that can outrun every unboosted Pokemon in the metagame, as well as a number of boosted Pokemon such as Quaquaval after Aqua Step, Choice Scarf Mienshao and Excadrill after Rapid Spin. Ogerpon's Speed boost also allows it to have unique interactions with Encore, switching in on faster Pokemon to lock them into set up moves such as Calm Mind Latios or Nasty Plot Tornadus-T.

Ogerpon's pivoting and utility options are best suited on bulky offense teams that appreciate its ability to disrupt foes while bringing in their own threats. Wallbreakers such as Azumarill, Hisuian Arcanine, and Mamoswine love Ogerpon's ability to pivot them in safely, weaken their checks, and potentially set up Spikes for them to break more easily; In return, they are able to deal with some of Ogerpon's checks such as Heatran, Tornadus-T, and Hydrapple. Pivots that are able to synergize well with Ogerpon such as Slowking, Tornadus-T, and Rotom-W make for excellent partners, being able to form a strong core while relieving Ogerpon of the pressure of taking on threats like Latios, Excadrill, and Quaquaval. Stealth Rock setters such as Tinkaton and Cobalion mesh well with Ogerpon that opt for Spikes by maximizing the entry hazard stacking potential, with Tinkaton able to fit Encore instead while taking on Greninja and Weavile, while Cobalion can effectively deal with Excadrill and Lokix for it. Sandy Shocks is an excellent teammate for Ogerpon, being able to take on the Flying-types that it's afraid of, creating a VoltTurn core with it, and being able to set up Stealth Rock for it while Ogerpon handles the Water- and Grass-type attacks aimed at Sandy Shocks well while beating its key checks like Azumarill and Rotom-Wash.

Boots Pivot.description:
Ogerpon's high Attack and Speed, particularly after Terastallizing, along with its bevy of utility moves make it a reliable pivot and speed control that can disrupt the opposition. Knock Off gives Ogerpon a complementary coverage option to Ivy Cudgel and hits would-be checks like Gholdengo and Galarian Slowking; it also allows Ogerpon to support its team by permanently crippling its foes, particularly Stealth Rock-weak Pokemon like Dragonite, Moltres, and Kyurem that rely on Heavy-Duty Boots. U-turn is a fantastic option that can maintain momentum and chip down checks like Hydrapple while safely bringing in one of Ogerpon's teammates safely. Encore shuts down walls like Gliscor and Terastallized Garganacl as well as setup sweepers like Kingambit and Raging Bolt; after Terastallizing, its fast Encore is also helpful to shut down faster setup sweepers like Zamazenta.

Ogerpon should feel right at home on bulkier teams in need of a fast pivot. It struggles to make progress against Fire-types such as Moltres and Heatran, often requiring them to be weakened or removed in order to start threatening teams. Thus, Garganacl and Gliscor make great teammates, as they manage to consistently switch into and threaten these Pokemon, set entry hazards for Ogerpon to take advantage of, and easily spread chip damage to wear down the opposing team. Ogerpon's ability to threaten Water-types like Primarina and Ogerpon-W is also greatly appreciated by both Pokemon. Alomomola is another valuable teammate thanks to its high bulk, low Speed, and access to Flip Turn allowing it to safely and consistently bring Ogerpon onto the field, as well as being able to check the likes of Zamazenta and Cinderace. Additionally, Ogerpon with another fast wallbreaker can make for an efficient and potent wallbreaking core; therefore, Pokemon such as Weavile and Deoxys-S that help overwhelm Ogerpon's checks like Corviknight and Moltres make excellent teammates. It also enjoys having these Pokemon as naturally faster teammates as opposed to relying on Terastallization for speed control, and it likewise appreciates them for being able to threaten bulkier Dragon-types like Dragonite and Raging Bolt. Lastly, special tanks such as Galarian Slowking and Ting-Lu can safely switch in on powerful special wallbreakers like Dragapult and Iron Moth, and they also appreciate Ogerpon's reliability in punishing switch-ins like Landorus-T.

Choice Band.description:
Choice Band Ogerpon whacks its way into the OU metagame with its nuclear Ivy Cudgel alongside the valuable Speed boost from Embody Aspect and great coverage options, letting it wallbreak while also revenge kill threats and potentially clean late-game as well. After Terastallization, Ogerpon can outrun and revenge kill Choice Scarf users like Hisuian Samurott and Enamorus and foes like Zamazenta, Darkrai, and Dragapult that outspeed it naturally as well as boosting Ivy Cudgel to 2HKO checks like Gholdengo. Knock Off allows Ogerpon to annoy many of its checks, such as Moltres, Zapdos, Pecharunt, and Galarian Weezing, while taking out Grass-resistant foes like Gholdengo, Galarian Slowking, and Dragapult. U-turn allows Ogerpon to chip its checks and bring a teammate in safely on its switchins while providing super effective coverage against Grass-types like Rillaboom, Hydrapple, as well as opposing Ogerpon formes. Low Kick allows Ogerpon to break through foes that can shrug off Ivy Cudgel fairly well such as Kingambit, Kyurem, and Heatran, while Rock Tomb drops Moltres, Dragonite, Iron Moth, and Zapdos, even doing so without risking an adverse contact effect like a Flame Body burn or Static paralysis.

Ogerpon's main use is on balance and bulky offense teams as a wallbreaker and revenge killer, though it sees some play on offensive teams as a cleaner. Ogerpon is susceptible to entry hazard damage over the course of the game, so teammates like Great Tusk, Cinderace, and Corviknight that can remove said hazards from Ogerpon's side of the field are especially valued. Cinderace and Great Tusk in particular pair well with Ogerpon, as both appreciate roadblocks like Dondozo being taken down by Ogerpon, while they are able to deal with Gholdengo, Kingambit, and Heatran. Teammates that set hazards, such as Great Tusk, Hisuian Samurott, and Garganacl, synergize very well with Ogerpon and its ability to remove Heavy-Duty Boots from foes like Moltres and Corviknight. Offensive teammates like Deoxys-S, Gholdengo, and Iron Crown that threaten Ogerpon's checks like Galarian Weezing and Pecharunt are highly appreciated as well, while Ogerpon can bring them in on the aforementioned Poison-types with U-turn. Another great offensive teammate is Choice Specs Raging Bolt, as it obliterates the likes of Moltres, Zapdos, and Corviknight, while Ogerpon smashes Ground-types like Gliscor. Finally, slow pivots like Alomomola and Galarian Slowking work well with Ogerpon, as they give it free entry points to throw off its dangerous attacks without having to withstand powerful responses while checking threatening answers like Zamazenta.

Choice Band (Atk).description:
Choice Band Ogerpon is a devastating wallbreaker, making excellent use of an Attack donation to push its already strong Ivy Cudgel to absurd levels of power. Ivy Cudgel deals massive damage to neutral targets and even threatens Pokemon that resist it after chip damage. Knock Off provides crucial utility by removing items such as Heavy-Duty Boots and Leftovers from checks like Moltres and Pecharunt, making them much easier to wear down over the course of the game. U-turn allows Ogerpon to maintain momentum, punishing switches and bringing in teammates safely against checks. Stomping Tantrum provides consistent coverage against Steel- and Fire-types such as Zacian-C and Iron Moth without drawbacks, while Superpower is an option for the likes of Kyurem-White and Archaludon. Alternatively, Rock Tomb allows Ogerpon to hit Flying-types such as Moltres and Zapdos without making contact. Defiant allows Ogerpon to punish Intimidate from Landorus-T and Parting Shot from Pecharunt, while Tera Grass with Embody Aspect (Teal) essentially allows Ogerpon to hold both a Choice Band and a Choice Scarf simultaneously, making it extremely potent at cleaning.

Ogerpon fits best on offensive and bulky offense teams that can capitalize on its wallbreaking ability. Entry hazard support from teammates such as Clefable and Landorus-T is especially valuable, as Ogerpon forces frequent switches and can remove Heavy-Duty Boots with Knock Off, compounding hazard damage. Because Ogerpon is vulnerable to entry hazards itself and lacks recovery, hazard removal from options like Great Tusk and Iron Treads is highly appreciated. Additionally, Ogerpon's frailty means it benefits greatly from pivot support from Pokemon such as Rotom-W and the aforementioned Landorus-T, which can bring it in safely to apply pressure. Strong special attackers like Iron Moth and Gholdengo also pair well with Ogerpon, as they can take advantage of the physical walls like that Ogerpon brings in. Also, as Ogerpon is incredibly difficult to switch into, its counters are limited to Pokemon such as Skarmory and Corviknight, so teammates that can shut them down like Hatterene for Skarmory and the aforementioned Gholdengo for Corviknight are useful.

ou.overview: With its outstanding power, good Speed, and variety of coverage and utility moves, Ogerpon-W is one of OU's premier physical attackers. The high power of Ivy Cudgel and Power Whip, the option to trade the latter with Trailblaze to outspeed otherwise faster foes such as Dragapult and Deoxys-S, and the option for coverage in Play Rough to nail Dragon-types such as Kyurem and Raging Bolt come together alongside Swords Dance to make Ogerpon-W a potent wallbreaker. Moreover, the non-contact nature of its Ivy Cudgel also allow it to ignore otherwise-debilitating effects from Moltres's Flame Body, Zapdos's Static, and Corviknight's Rocky Helmet, and its high critical hit nature means it can potentially go toe-to-toe with Defense-boosting foes like Corviknight and Terastallized Garganacl. In addition, utility attacks such as Knock Off to cripple checks like Pecharunt, Zapdos, and Dragonite, as well as U-turn to pivot on predicted switches and bring teammates in safely, means that Ogerpon-W can also run an all-out attacker set rather effectively. Moves such as Spikes, Taunt, and Encore allow it to act as a utility Pokemon able to further support its teammates beyond attacking, making the most out of the many switches it forces to progress the game. Moreover, the defensive utility granted by Water Absorb lets Ogerpon-W get on the field safely against the likes of Walking Wake and, more importantly, Alomomola and Dondozo. After Terastallization, the additional Special Defense boost also lets it take on special attackers that may otherwise pressure it, such as Iron Moth and Tornadus-T. However, Dragon- and Grass-types such as Raging Bolt, Kyurem, Hydrapple, and Sinistcha, as well as Pecharunt, can prove hard for Ogerpon-W to make progress against if it is not running the adequate coverage. Despite its good Speed, Ogerpon-W is still outsped and threatened by the likes of Tornadus-T, Dragapult, and Zamazenta. Being locked into Tera Water means that it lacks the surprise factor and set variability that other top-tier Pokemon such as Dragonite and Kingambit possess. This also applies to the fact that Ogerpon-W is locked into Wellspring Mask; particularly, Ogerpon-W does not have the option to run Heavy-Duty Boots, so it is often necessitated to be run on highly offensive teams that can forgo use of entry hazard removal or alongside partners that can provide it such as Great Tusk, Iron Treads, and Cinderace.
ou.comments:
Other Options

Swords Dance sets may use Grassy Glide when paired with Rillaboom and its Grassy Surge, granting Ogerpon-W the opportunity to get the jump on and threaten to OHKO Pokemon that would otherwise revenge kill it, such as Darkrai and Deoxys-S, after a Swords Dance boost while also letting it revenge kill weakened foes such as +1 Walking Wake and Great Tusk. Ogerpon-W may opt to run bulky EV spreads alongside Synthesis on its Swords Dance and utility sets, such as investing 252 EVs in HP to make it a sturdier check against the likes of Ting-Lu, Great Tusk, and Iron Treads; in particular the investment allows it to avoid OHKOs from the likes of Choice Specs Dragapult's Draco Meteor, Life Orb Zamazenta's Close Combat, and +2 Gholdengo's Shadow Ball. Spiky Shield may be used to scout attacks from Choice item users such as Dragapult, Walking Wake, and Darkrai, stop revenge killing attempts from Lokix and Slither Wing's First Impression, and chip at physical attackers to put them in range of Ogerpon-W's attack. Low Kick and Superpower may be considered to OHKO Kingambit, as well as Kyurem after a round of Stealth Rock, with Superpower making up for its drops by also netting an OHKO against Darkrai. Finally, Wood Hammer may be run over Power Whip due to its accuracy.

Utility.description:
Ogerpon-W can function as an excellent utility piece on balance and bulky offensive teams, primarily those based around hazard stacking. This is courtesy of it being one of the best offensive Spikers in the metagame, as it forces switches consistently by threatening common Pokemon like Great Tusk, Ting-Lu, and Landorus-T. U-turn enables Ogerpon-W to gain momentum on usual switch-ins like Dragonite, Kyurem, and Hydrapple while also giving it a super effective move against opposing Ogerpon formes and Hisuian Samurott. Knock Off can be used to cripple defensive cores that are reliant on Heavy-Duty Boots like Pecharunt and Dragonite while also hitting Dragapult and Sinistcha super effectively. Spikes helps apply constant pressure against a variety of playstyles, especially when used in combination with Knock Off. Synthesis provides some much-needed longevity to Ogerpon-W, considering it is a hazard-weak pokemon itself while also enabling it to switch in multiple times on moves like Ting-Lu's Ruination and Great Tusk's Headlong Rush. Encore and Taunt are alternatives that compromise on longevity but help improve other matchups. Encore grants it easier setup opportunities by punishing passive play, such as Corviknight into Iron Defense and Dragonite into Roost, and also helps limit setup sweepers like Swords Dance Gliscor, Calm Mind Raging Bolt, and Swords Dance Kingambit. Taunt is useful in preventing hazards from going up, improves matchups against more defensively oriented teams by preventing recovery moves like Roost on Corviknight and Rest on Dondozo, and prevents status moves like Toxic from Gliscor and Will-O-Wisp from Galarian Weezing. Dropping U-turn in place of Knock Off can be considered in cases where the team lacks ways to remove Heavy-Duty Boots. An alternative spread of 8 HP / 12 Def / 236 Atk / 252 Spe permits Ogerpon-W to survive a Power Whip from full from opposing Ogerpon formes and a Close Combat from maximum Attack Iron Valiant and Great Tusk after Stealth Rock. A well-timed Terastallization can also turn Ogerpon-W from a utility Spiker to a decent wallbreaker in the right matchup, securing crucial 2HKOs with Ivy Cudgel on Pokemon like Zapdos.

Utility Ogerpon-W functions best on entry hazard-stacking structures that aim to get hazards up quickly and pressure multiple switches through offensive momentum. Stealth Rock users like Great Tusk, Ting-Lu, and Garganacl partner well with Ogerpon-W to form a hazard-stacking duo. Garganacl in particular synergizes well with Ogerpon-W, as it handles problematic Pokemon like Zapdos, Dragapult, and Pecharunt. Other Spikers like Hisuian Samurott and Skarmory also complement Ogerpon-W well in cases where it opts not to run Spikes. This set becomes doubly effective when used in conjunction with another Knock Off user in order to maximize the pressure mounted by hazards. Pokemon like Darkrai, Iron Treads, and Gliscor are excellent teammates in this regard. Iron Treads helps keep hazards off, serves as a secondary Knock Off user, and matches up well against Pokemon like Raging Bolt and Dragonite that like to come in on Ogerpon-W. In return, Ogerpon-W helps against Ground- and Fire-types that Iron Treads struggles against, like Moltres, Great Tusk, and Gliscor. Moltres and Zapdos can pair well with Ogerpon-W to create a pivoting core while also helping against physical threats like Zamazenta and Cinderace, which can outspeed and threaten Ogerpon-W. They also provide the added benefit of punishing common spinners. Pecharunt can perform the role of a pivoting teammate to great effect due to Parting Shot while also acting as a spinblocker. These pivoting teammates help bring Ogerpon-W in safely, improving its longevity on sets that elect to drop Synthesis. Pokemon that struggle against Ground-types and Ting-Lu in particular, such as Raging Bolt, Gholdengo, and Iron Crown, greatly appreciate the utility provided by Ogerpon-W. Late-game cleaners like IronPress Zamazenta and Swords Dance Kingambit also make great teammates since they are often perfectly set up to win late-game by the pressure mounted through the course of the game by Ogerpon-W and hazard stacking. Due to a lack of Grass-type coverage, this set sometimes struggles to break common bulky Water-types like Primarina, Toxapex, and Tera Water Garganacl, though they can be pressured by hazards and Knock Off. Galarian Slowking and Garganacl both cover these matchups perfectly.

Swords Dance.description:
Ogerpon-W can utilize the explosive power boost gifted to it by Swords Dance to become truly nigh-unwallable wallbreaker. Trailblaze lets it get the jump on otherwise faster Pokemon such as Dragapult, Darkrai, Zamazenta, and some Choice Scarf users like Enamorus and Gholdengo, letting it also clean up late-game. On paper, regular Dragon-types may come in as checks; however, Ogerpon-W has can adapt its arsenal for them by using Play Rough to hit foes like Dragonite, Raging Bolt, and Walking Wake. Power Whip's immediate damage is preferred to wallbreak better, notably letting it threaten foes like Toxapex and even OHKO Tera Water walls like Gliscor and Clefable right away. Synthesis may also be used to gain a consistent form of recovery while still utilizing Ogerpon-W’s nature to frequently force switches, mitigating its weakness against entry hazards and preventing it from being picked off easily by faster threats. Knock Off allows it to remove Heavy-Duty Boots from checks such as Zapdos, Pecharunt, Dragonite, and Kyurem while threatening foes like Dragapult and Sinistcha super effectively. Substitute allows Ogerpon-W to fully exploit Garganacl and Alomomola that greedily attempt to hinder it with Salt Cure and Body Slam and, after Terastallizing, use checks like Galarian Weezing and potentially non-Foul Play Pecharunt as setup fodder, as they're unable to reliably break its Substitute with a single attack nor cripple Ogerpon-W with Will-O-Wisp and Malignant Chain's poison. Keeping a Substitute up also gives it protection against revenge killing attempts from foes like Lokix, Tornadus-T, and Rillaboom while giving it a safety net in the face of Kingambit's Sucker Punch and Raging Bolt's Thunderclap. Encore is an option to take full advantage of passive walls, like Corviknight into Iron Defense, to gain free set up while also punishing Kingambit’s Sucker Punch or Raging Bolt’s Thunderclap. Horn Leech gives it a Grass-type STAB move while providing decent recovery similar to Synthesis, and is especially more notable on Substitute variants to help mitigate the health loss.

Despite the fact that Ogerpon-W is locked into Tera Water, it still makes incredible use of it by making quick work of everything that doesn’t resist Ivy Cudgel, and even at that, many Water-resistant foes still struggle to tank it. Notably, +2 Attack Tera Water Ivy Cudgel always OHKOs Pokemon like Zapdos. The Special Defense boost warranted by Embody Aspect also helps in handling some Darkrai sets and special attacking Iron Valiant while also being able to take one Freeze-Dry from even Choice Specs Kyurem. Shedding its Grass typing also allows Ogerpon-W to take Sludge Wave from Iron Moth and Sludge Bomb from the likes of Galarian Slowking and Darkrai more comfortably. An Adamant nature is still very much usable: while Ogerpon-W losing out on a good chunk of its Speed for more power usually isn’t ideal, it’s definitely noteworthy. For example, +2 Attack Adamant Tera Water Ivy Cudgel always OHKOs Galarian Weezing, which otherwise may come off as a problem for it being able to burn Ogerpon-W while also OHKOing Corviknight after rocks. However, the Speed drop is noticeable, as Ogerpon-W is no longer able to outspeed Pokemon like Enamorous, Iron Crown, and Iron Treads.

Ogerpon-W finds itself commonly used on hyper offense, bulky offense, and sometimes even balance-oriented playstyles. On most teams, it has great synergy with special attacking Iron Valiant and Raging Bolt: it deals with special walls like Clodsire and Blissey that might trouble them, as well as Assault Vest Alomomola in the case of Iron Valiant. Iron Valiant, in turn, deals with Pokemon that can outspeed and revenge kill Ogerpon-W for it like Zamazenta, Choice Band Weavile, and Darkrai, while Raging Bolt returns the favor by dealing with Zapdos. Common Pokemon used as cleaners, such as Enamorous and Darkrai, also highly appreciate Ogerpon-W's presence, as it’s able to enable them for late-game cleaning. If Swords Dance hasn’t already ended the game, Ogerpon-W itself is often used as a late-game cleaner. Swords Dance also allows it to efficiently cover for teams with poor stall matchups, often on its own, by applying great pressure due to its positive matchup against common Pokemon such as Gliscor, Dondozo, and Blissey. Ogerpon-W also appreciates hazards being up on the opponent’s side, so Pokemon like Hisuian Samurott, Ting-Lu, and Deoxys-S help it out by letting Ogerpon-W OHKO Kingambit with a +2 Attack Ivy Cudgel after 1 layer of Spikes or OHKO Raging Bolt with a +2 Play Rough.

Ogerpon-W itself doesn’t have many direct counters; however, particular Pokemon like Kyurem can take an unboosted Play Rough and OHKO a non-Terastallized Ogerpon-W with Freeze-Dry. Because of this, Ogerpon-W likes having partners like Galarian Slowking and Tinkaton that can chip Kyurem down a little while being able to take a few hits from it. Galarian Slowking can provide safe pivots, while Tinkaton can set up Stealth Rock and threaten massive damage onto Kyurem with Gigaton Hammer. In return, Ogerpon-W helps by dealing with problematic Ground-types like Ting-Lu, Great Tusk, Gliscor, and Iron Treads. Raging Bolt may be a nuisance against Ogerpon-W lacking Play Rough, so once again, Great Tusk comes in as a great partner. Likewise, Dragonite is quite troublesome for Ogerpon-W lacking Play Rough: if Dragonite is running an unfavorable Tera type, then teammates like Zapdos are quite helpful. Ogerpon-W, when paired with Zamazenta and Dragonite, overwhelm shared checks like Pecharunt, Zapdos, and Galarian Weezing. Amoongus notably has a niche in OU for being able to wall Ogerpon-W effectively, so partners like Moltres, Kyurem, and Gholdengo lend a hand in breaking it. Pecharunt can also wall Ogerpon-W, as it can reliably stomach hits from even +2 Attack Ivy Cudgel, paired with the presence of Sinistcha also being unignorable by Ogerpon-W, partners such as Gholdengo, Darkrai, and Kingambit show themselves to be very beneficial. Dragapult can easily burn Ogerpon-W or chip it down with U-turn; though Kingambit also hates being burnt, it still very much helps against Dragapult. Ogerpon-W returns the favor by removing Kingambit’s checks like Dondozo, Great Tusk, and Moltres. Ogerpon-W by no means is bulky; thus, it highly appreciates being able to be safely brought onto the field, so partners like Galarian Slowking, Landorus-T, and Cinderace are extremely useful, with Ogerpon-W being able to threaten Pokemon that threaten them like Great Tusk or Gliscor. Ogerpon-W generally prospers in the absence of entry hazards, as it’s vulnerable to chip damage. Hazard removers such as Great Tusk really come in handy here, for which Ogerpon-W in turn helps by dealing with bulky Water-types like Alomomola and Dondozo.

All-Out Attacker.description:
Running four attacking moves gives Ogerpon-W excellent coverage against any opponent. Knock Off provides the team with a utility option to remove Heavy-Duty Boots from common users like Zapdos, Pecharunt, Dragonite, and Sinistcha, preventing them from switching in for free, as well as still targeting Dragapult. Power Whip is Ogerpon-W's strongest Grass-type move, letting it pressure Tera Water walls like Gliscor and Garganacl more easily, but Horn Leech gives Ogerpon-W some longevity in exchange for power. Ogerpon-W runs Play Rough for Dragon-types such as Dragonite, Kyurem, Raging Bolt, and Hydrapple. Trailblaze can be used to give it a solid late-game cleaning potential, letting it outspeed would-be revenge killers like Dragapult, Darkrai, and Choice Scarf Gholdengo after a boost. U-turn is an alternative that gives Ogerpon-W the ability to pivot out of bad matchups at the cost of potential coverage. Ogerpon-W benefits from running either a Jolly or Adamant nature: Jolly allows it to outspeed Walking Wake, Iron Crown, Enamorus, Iron Treads, and Keldeo, whereas Adamant can be used for more power, and is the preferred nature if running Trailblaze to help compensate for the Speed drop. Ogerpon-W is locked to Tera Water, which allows it to guarantee OHKOs with Ivy Cudgel against Darkrai and Iron Valiant. Tera Water also removes Ogerpon-W’s weakness to U-Turn and increases its survivability against foes like Iron Moth and Gholdengo thanks to Embody Aspect.

Ogerpon-W is an excellent addition to offense teams and supports them as a premier wallbreaker and revenge killer. Powerful offensive teammates like Dragonite and Kingambit form strong cores that can break down opposing structures: Dragonite can assist Ogerpon-W in pressuring foes like Pecharunt and Zapdos, while Kingambit checks Dragapult. Ogerpon-W returns the favor by threatening the likes of Great Tusk, Landorus-T, Moltres, and Dondozo. Ogerpon-W benefits from teammates that can set up entry hazards and keep them in place; hazards make it easier for its offensive output to break teams, and in return it can use Knock Off to remove Heavy-Duty Boots to rack up hazard damage. Great Tusk is a strong option that can set Stealth Rock as well as keep pressure on foes like Raging Bolt and Dragonite. Gholdengo can help block Rapid Spin and Defog while slowing enemies down with Thunder Wave, giving Ogerpon-W more opportunities to deal damage. Lastly, Ting-Lu can help check Raging Bolt, Pecharunt, and Dragapult. Dragapult is also a great teammate that helps Ogerpon-W by spreading paralysis to help it outspeed foes, using U-turn to pivot it in safely. Ogerpon-W in turn threatens Garganacl, Ting-Lu, Primarina, and Assault Vest Alomomola, all of which give Dragapult trouble. Raging Bolt is another option that can pick off foes weakened by Ogerpon-W with priority Thunderclap; Ogerpon-W complements Raging Bolt by dealing with threats like Great Tusk, Ting-Lu, and Iron Treads. Together, Ogerpon-W, Dragapult, and Raging Bolt can form VoltTurn pivot cores to keep strong momentum between them. Ogerpon-W is relatively frail and susceptible to taking hits from opposing offensive Pokemon like Dragonite and Iron Valiant as well as entry hazards due to lack of Heavy-Duty Boots. Defensive teammates like Zamazenta can help cover Dragonite, taking little damage from its attacks and stopping it from boosting with Dragon Dance by using Roar. Garganacl is another solid defensive teammate that can handle attacks from foes like Pecharunt, Dragapult, and Zapdos, wearing them down with Stealth Rock and Salt Cure. Ogerpon-W struggles to break through certain defensive walls like Zamazenta and Pecharunt; having powerful teammates like Iron Valiant or the aforementioned Dragapult for the former along with Darkrai or Galarian Slowking for the latter can help take care of said walls as well as keep up offensive pressure throughout the game.

Offensive.description:
• Ogerpon-W is a very strong offensive threat with a wide movepool capable of adapting itself to a variety of threats in 1v1.
  • Power Whip hits opposing Water- and Ground-types like Primarina and Ursaluna. Wood Hammer may be used to not deal with Power Whip's 85% accuracy, though taking recoil may cause Ogerpon-W to lose some matchups that Power Whip would be a better fit for, such as against opposing Ogerpon-W.
  • Ivy Cudgel muscles through Fire- and Ground-types like Volcarona, Heatran, and Landorus-T.
  • Ogerpon-W's blisteringly fast base 110 Speed allows it to shut down many defensive threats that enjoy boosting their Defense stat such as Corviknight and Iron Crown by locking them into a status move with Encore.
  • Superpower may be used to secure KOs on threats that would otherwise survive Ogerpon-W's STAB attacks such as bulky Choice Specs Porygon-Z and non-Counter Hisuian Goodra.
  • U-turn can KO bulkier, slower Hoopa-U sets that would survive Ogerpon-W's other moves.
  • Knock Off can be used to outplay Custap Berry Pokemon such as Skeledirge and faster Choice Scarf users like Metagross.
  • Trailblaze lets Ogerpon-W get the jump on faster Pokemon that could potentially outplay it such as Encore + Disable Iron Valiant.
  • Spiky Shield can be used to secure OHKOs against Pokemon like Custap Berry Skeledirge and can stop Fly from Landorus-T.
  • Ogerpon-W's Speed is maximized to outspeed Alolan Ninetales and Speed tie itself in the mirror matchup. The rest of the EVs are placed to maximize its Attack.
  • Because of Ogerpon-W's immense strength, versatility, and Speed, its moveset is completely flexible and can open a myriad of options for its partners. Unfortunately, offensive Ogerpon-W can be overwhelmed by threats that can survive an attack and KO it back, such as Haxorus, so partners that help Ogerpon-W overcome this issue like Sylveon and Iron Crown are helpful.

Charm.description:
• Charm + Synthesis allows Ogerpon-W to outlast slower physical attackers like Haxorus and Iron Hands. Synthesis can also help defeat Draco Meteor users like Speed Booster Energy Walking Wake.
  • Ivy Cudgel is a reliable Water-type STAB move used to chip down the likes of Metagross and Skeledirge.
  • Power Whip is used primarily to take down other Water-types, most notably Primarina and Urshifu-R.
  • If some of these Pokemon are already well covered by a partner, Encore is worth considering. Encore can foil the plans of some setup Pokemon, such as Swords Dance Iron Hands, that would otherwise outlast Charm and then KO Ogerpon-W. Encore also allows for it to break through some stall Pokemon, such as Reflect + Calm Mind Cresselia.
  • 152 Speed EVs and a Jolly nature allow Ogerpon-W to outspeed Haxorus and Urshifu. The defensive investment gives the best chances to survive a Close Combat from Choice Band Urshifu, allowing Ogerpon-W to be sent in against both of its formes without having to guess at Team Preview.

Specially Defensive.description:
• Power Whip is for Primarina and non-Sap Sipper Azumarill and is the best option against non-positive Defense-natured Sylveon.
  • Ivy Cudgel is for non-Passho Berry Volcarona and Rhyperior.
  • Knock Off should be used against Spectrier and Porygon-Z.
  • Superpower guarantees the matchup against both Hisuian Goodra and bulkier Porygon-Z sets after Knock Off, while Encore allows Ogerpon-W to defeat Pokemon like Registeel.
  • The Speed EVs allow Ogerpon-W to outspeed non-Choice Scarf Porygon-Z, while the HP and Special Defense EVs give it the best roll to survive Hyper Beam from Modest Porygon-Z after Ogerpon-W's Knock Off.
  • If Power Whip and another move both KO an opposing Pokemon, it is best to use the other move due to accuracy.
  • Against slower Pokemon that attempt to stall out Ogerpon-W, Encore can be used to lock them into a status move.
  • Knock Off can also be used in some matchups to remove an opposing Custap Berry on the turn that Pokemon like Custap Berry Sylveon use Endure.

SubSeed.description:
• Maximum Speed is to outspeed everything Ogerpon-W can, including non-Choice Scarf Landorus-T and Manaphy.
  • The Defense EVs let Ogerpon-W survive Choice Band Metagross's Psychic Fangs, while the Special Defense EVs let it take Ursaluna-B's combo of Blood Moon and Vacuum Wave.
  • Ogerpon-W should use Leech Seed turn one and then alternate between Spiky Shield and Substitute until the foe is KOed or is within range of Ogerpon-W's attacks.
  • Without Spiky Shield, Ogerpon-W relies more on its offensive capabilities. After using Leech Seed, it should use Substitute until it's able to KO foes with either Power Whip or Ivy Cudgel.
  • Leech Seed and Substitute are standard for the strategy. While Spiky Shield isn't mandatory, it is usually used to increase healing from Leech Seed and to stall out the foe's HP.
  • One or two attacking moves are used; Ivy Cudgel is better for hitting Fire-, Ground-, and Rock-types like Landorus-T, Skeledirge, and Rhyperior for super effective damage and is better against IronPress sets from Pokemon like Registeel and Corviknight because of Ivy Cudgel's higher crit rate. Power Whip's main advantage is that it is better against Water-types, like Primarina and Manaphy.

Defensive.description:
• This Ogerpon-W takes a more defensive route thanks to its decent bulk and access to Counter in order to flip otherwise losing matchups, such as against non-Triple Axel Meowscarada.
  • Power Whip hits Water-type Pokemon such as Primarina super effectively and is Ogerpon-W's best option against neutral matchups like Sylveon.
  • Ivy Cudgel threatens Fire- and Ground-type Pokemon such as Skeledirge and Landorus-T.
  • Counter allows defensive Ogerpon-W to retaliate against physical foes that would either threaten to KO it or feel that a physical attack is their best move against offensive Ogerpon-W sets, such as non-Triple Axel Choice Band Meowscarada and opposing Ogerpon-W. Alternatively, Knock Off may be used to remove Custap Berry from Pokemon such as Skeledirge.
  • U-turn is Ogerpon-W's best option against non-defensive Hoopa-U, since it gets OHKOed. Alternatively, Encore is useful to lock down a slower foe focused on boosting their stats, such as Cresselia and defensive Iron Crown, or to outplay Endure Custap Berry sets from Pokemon such as Sylveon and Skeledirge.
  • The Speed EVs allow Ogerpon-W to outspeed Hoopa-U whereas the HP and Defense EVs give Ogerpon-W the best rolls against Adamant Choice Band Meowscarada.
  • Defensive Ogerpon-W won't have the firepower to threaten Pokemon like Fast Choice Specs Porygon-Z, Bulky Hoopa-U, and Ursaluna, so teammates that can cover this weakness such as Corviknight are appreciated.

monotype.comments:
Other Options

Water

Superpower is a niche move that destroys the Steel matchup after a Swords Dance.

Swords Dance (Water).description:
Ogerpon-W boasts a great Attack stat complemented by an amazing Speed stat, which lets it outspeed a great number of foes such as Landorus, Hydreigon, and Keldeo, allowing it to serve as a setup sweeper on both rain and rainless Water teams. Ivy Cudgel dismantles foes such as offensive Gholdengo, Zapdos, and Galarian Slowking after a Swords Dance. Horn Leech threatens enemies such as Primarina and Keldeo. Power Whip can be used in place of Horn Leech for more power over accuracy, allowing Ogerpon-W to clean up walls such as Toxapex, Clodsire, Ting-Lu, and Hatterene after a Swords Dance. Play Rough threatens Dragon-types such as Dragonite and Kommo-o, which resist both of Ogerpon-W's STAB moves. Alternatively, Knock Off removes items such as Leftovers from annoying foes like Archaludon and Corviknight while also threatening Brambleghast. Trailblaze is another option to boost Ogerpon-W's Speed, allowing it to out wipe out Rock, Ground, and Fire teams on its own.

Swampert provides an immunity to Electric-type attacks, sets entry hazards for the team, and possesses a slow pivot option via Flip Turn, allowing Ogerpon-W to safely come on a weakened threat to set up. Hisuian Samurott is another partner that provides hazard support via Ceaseless Edge. It also checks fast foes like Dragapult and chipped Choice Specs Flutter Mane with Sucker Punch as well as annoying foes such as Archaludon with Sacred Sword. Greninja forms an offensive core with Ogerpon-W, serving as the special attacker of the team and helping in removing Dragonite and Ogerpon-H. Primarina is another setup sweeper that finds success in disrupting Dragon-types such as Roaring Moon and Archaludon with Draining Kiss. Toxapex is an excellent wall to deal with foes like Kleavor and Meowscarada. Toxapex spreads poison with Toxic or Toxic Spikes to wear down Iron Hands and Sinistcha, allowing Ogerpon-W to clean them up with ease. When slotted on rain teams, Ogerpon-W enjoys Pelipper's ability to set up rain and easily pivot in it using U-turn against Hisuian Samurott. Rain allows Ogerpon-W's Ivy Cudgel to OHKO foes such as Ting-Lu and Alolan Muk after Stealth Rock damage. In rain, Barraskewda breaks through Ogerpon-W's checks such as Sneasler and Tornadus-T. Empoleon provides a switch-in against special attacks from foes like Articuno and Kyurem and threatens them back. It also punishes attempts to Defog with Competitive and provides utility with Stealth Rock, Flip Turn, and Roar. Gastrodon is another defensive ally of Ogerpon-W that can be annoying to remove due to its bulk and access to Recover. It can set up hazards such as Spikes and Stealth Rock as well as disrupt foes like Gliscor and Gholdengo with Earth Power and Ice Beam.

Offensive Redirector.description:
Ogerpon-W is often used to redirect attacks and threaten common Fire-types such as Incineroar and Chi-Yu and Ground-types such as Ursaluna-B and Landorus with Ivy Cudgel. Ogerpon-W has excellent matchups into Urshifu-R and Kyogre, both of which struggle to deal significant damage to Ogerpon-W while it can threaten them with Horn Leech or Wood Hammer. Horn Leech is used to deal consistent damage while boosting Ogerpon-W's longevity, while Wood Hammer allows Ogerpon-W to OHKO Flutter Mane and Kyogre. Ogerpon-W also matches up well into Calyrex-S and Ursaluna-B after it Terastallizes, threatening to 2HKO Calyrex-S and OHKO Ursaluna-B with Tera Water Ivy Cudgel. The HP and Defense investment allows Ogerpon-W to survive Collision Course in sun from Koraidon, Wood Hammer from Assault Vest Rillaboom, and two High Horsepowers from Calyrex-I after Terastallizing, and it gives it a high chance of surviving two Behemoth Blades from Zacian-C. The HP and Special Defense investment allows Ogerpon-W to survive Astral Barrage from Tera Ghost Choice Specs Calyrex-S, Discharge from Choice Specs Miraidon, and, when Terastallized, Blood Moon from Ursaluna-B; Ogerpon-W also has a high chance of surviving Overheat from Chi-Yu. The Attack investment allows Ogerpon-W to 2HKO Incineroar after Intimidate, and the Speed investment allows Ogerpon-W to outrun Landorus.

Ogerpon-W's redirection makes it an ideal partner for Pokemon that want to set up freely and frail offensive threats that can be KOed easily such as Calm Mind Terapagos and Choice Specs Calyrex-S, respectively. Ogerpon-W survives attacks such as Collision Course from Koraidon and Close Combat from Urshifu-R, which threaten Terapagos, and can redirect Sucker Punch from Chien-Pao, which threatens Calyrex-S. Ogerpon-W also threatens checks to Calyrex-S such as Incineroar and Chi-Yu. Ogerpon-W struggles against Miraidon, Raging Bolt, and Rillaboom, all of which wall and threaten it. Calyrex-I threatens all of these, making it an ideal partner for Ogerpon-W. Ogerpon-W benefits Calyrex-I by threatening Incineroar and redirecting attacks, such as Knock Off and Will-O-Wisp, that hinder Calyrex-I. A partner Incineroar also pairs well with Ogerpon-W, with Incineroar's Intimidate and Ogerpon-W's Embody Aspect working in tandem to make Ogerpon-W difficult to remove. Ogerpon-W supports Incineroar by redirecting attacks that threaten Incineroar such as Surging Strikes from Urshifu-R and Earth Power from Ursaluna-B.

Swords Dance.description:
Ogerpon-W is a very threatening wallbreaker that gets many opportunities to set up with Swords Dance, as it can threaten key defensive pieces like Landorus-T, Great Tusk, and Heatran with its STAB moves. Power Whip is the preferred option, as it OHKOes Great Tusk and Alomomola, but Horn Leech can keep Ogerpon-W healthy. Superpower hits potential switch-ins such as Ferrothorn and Archaludon. Play Rough can allow Ogerpon-W to target foes such as Dragonite, Raging Bolt, and Mega Latios, which would otherwise switch in comfortably.

Ogerpon-W tends to fit on many different playstyles from hyper offense to balance, as it is a potent wallbreaker capable of threatening defensive teams. Its Water immunity is also appreciated against rain teams. Pokemon like Great Tusk and Landorus-T value Ogerpon-W's ability to break through bulky Water-types such as Alomomola, Slowbro, and Dondozo. In return, these two provide Stealth Rock support as well as an Electric immunity that can stop revenge killing attempts from Tapu Koko and Raging Bolt. In addition, both teammates can provide entry hazard removal, which Ogerpon-W appreciates, as it is vulnerable to chip damage. Ogerpon-W struggles with threats like Raging Bolt, Mega Latios, and Mega Latias, so Pursuit trappers like Kingambit and Mega Tyranitar are welcomed. Ogerpon-W does not like taking many hits, so it appreciates U-turn from teammates such as Landorus-T and Tapu Koko to enter the field safely against Pokemon that want to come in on them such as Alomomola for the former and Ting-Lu for the latter. Non-Superpower Ogerpon-W can struggle to dent checks such as Ferrothorn and Archaludon, so Pokemon like Zamazenta and Mega Lopunny are valued to make up for the lack of coverage. Non-Play Rough Ogerpon-W should have partners that can pressure checks like Dragonite and Raging Bolt like Great Tusk and Tapu Koko.

Offensive Pivot.description:
Ogerpon-W is an offensive pivot that threatens common defensive Pokemon like Landorus-T, Gliscor, and Heatran. Courtesy of its ability, Ogerpon-W can answer a plethora of offensive Water-types, such as Mega Swampert and Urshifu-R, while ignoring Scald and Flip Turn from Slowbro, Toxapex, and Alomomola. Power Whip OKHOes Ursaluna and Great Tusk after minor chip damage, whereas Horn Leech provides it with longevity in exchange for power. U-turn allows Ogerpon-W to pivot out of checks such as Raging Bolt, Ferrothorn, and Dragonite. Knock Off is used to cripple switch-ins like Dragonite and Ferrothorn by removing their Heavy-Duty Boots and Leftovers, respectively. Alternatively, Encore can lock certain defensive pieces into recovery moves such as Toxapex and Mega Scizor. Encore also helps Ogerpon-W avoid mind games against priority moves from Raging Bolt and Kingambit and denies faster Pokemon like Zamazenta from setting up on it. Taunt is also an option to deny entry hazard-setting attempts from walls such as Ferrothorn and Clefable while ensuring Ogerpon-W walls Toxapex and Alomomola. Spikes can be used to wear down checks such as Ferrothorn and Raging Bolt lacking Heavy-Duty Boots, as it has the remarkable ability to force switches.

Ogerpon-W commonly fits on bulky offense and balance teams. Pokemon such as Great Tusk and Landorus-T appreciate its presence due to its ability to threaten foes such as Alomomola, Urshifu-R, and Moltres. In return, these teammates can provide entry hazard removal through Rapid Spin and Defog to prevent Ogerpon-W from being worn down quickly. Additionally, Landorus-T can bring it in with U-turn against Pokemon like Alomomola and Gliscor. Ogerpon-W is vulnerable to faster threats such as Iron Valiant and Zamazenta, so it appreciates teammates like bulky Volcarona and Landorus-T to answer Iron Valiant and check Zamazenta, respectively. Ogerpon-W also loves Spikes support from Pokemon like Mega Diancie to wear down checks such as Ferrothorn and Raging Bolt and help rack up chip damage in combination with U-turn.

Swords Dance.description:
• This set's write-up has not started yet, but here's some basic info to get you started!

  • 4 HP / 196 Atk / 52 Def / 4 SpD / 252 Spe with Jolly: This spread lets Embody Aspect Ogerpon-W survive both Choice Specs Flutter Mane's Tera Fairy Moonblast and Adamant Ogerpon-H's +1 Tera Fire Ivy Cudgel after Stealth Rock damage.

  • 156 HP / 156 Atk / 4 Def / 12 SpD / 180 Spe with Adamant: This spread lets Embody Aspect Ogerpon-W survive Tera Normal Silk Scarf Ursaluna-B's Blood Moon. It also outspeeds Modest Chi-Yu and survives Adamant Urshifu's Close Combat after Stealth Rock damage.

Specially Defensive.description:
• Ogerpon-W's great support movepool and Embody Aspect's Special Defense boost give it the opportunity to face premier special attackers such as Flutter Mane, Ursaluna-B, and Gholdengo head-on.

  • Horn Leech: Horn Leech's recovery can help maintain Ogerpon-W's defensive profile without compromising its offenses.

  • Substitute: Substitute has great synergy alongside Ogerpon-W's other support moves, especially Leech Seed. It's also useful for blocking status moves from foes like Ursaluna-B and Archaludon.

  • Leech Seed versus Synthesis: Due to being forced to run Wellspring Mask, Ogerpon-W misses passive recovery from items such as Leftovers, making Leech Seed a solid option for recovery. Synthesis is a more reliable recovery option at the cost of making Ogerpon-W more vulnerable to Archaludon.

  • Encore: Locking targets into an undesirable move can discourage setup attempts and passive play and allow opportunities for healing.

EV Spreads

  • 252 HP / 4 Atk / 4 Def / 188 SpD / 60 Spe with Careful: This spread aims to maximize Ogerpon-W's special bulk, and it outspeeds Modest Gholdengo, positive Speed-natured base 70 Speed foes such as Jolly Breloom, and neutral-natured base 85 Speed foes such as Rillaboom.

  • 236 HP / 4 Atk / 52 Def / 156 SpD / 60 Spe with Careful: If using Substitute and Leech Seed, this spread sacrifices some special bulk in exchange for letting Substitute withstand Archaludon's Dragon Tail.

Embody Aspect

Ogerpon-W is locked into a Water Tera type. When it Terastallizes, Water Absorb becomes Embody Aspect. This forme's Embody Aspect boosts Special Defense, making it essentially like an Assault Vest without the downsides, which can be key to taking strong hits such as those from Choice Specs Tera Fairy Flutter Mane and Tera Normal Ursaluna-B.

Offensive Redirector.description:
Ogerpon-W is a threatening offensive redirector, using its good stats and strong movepool to check metagame threats such as Landorus and Heatran, as well as providing a useful Water immunity to teammates. Ivy Cudgel is useful as a strong Water-type move for Ogerpon-W and a strong Grass-type move for teammates. In a pinch, Ogerpon-W can also use Ivy Cudgel on a teammate to provide a small bit of healing thanks to Water Absorb. Wood Hammer is stronger, at the cost of having recoil, while Horn Leech improves Ogerpon-W's longevity throughout a battle. Follow Me helps allies like Gholdengo and Iron Hands to set up, as well as helping Trick Room users such as Porygon2 to set it up safely. Spiky Shield is a useful option that can protect Ogerpon-W from double targets and help it stall out Trick Room, while Swords Dance synergizes well with Follow Me and can be used if other teammates are carrying Protect. The given EV spread allows it to outspeed Landorus and survive Landorus's Sludge Bomb, with the rest being put in Attack. Ogerpon-W struggles against Grass- and Dragon-types such as Rillaboom, Sinistcha, Dragonite, and Raging Bolt, as they resist Ogerpon-W's STAB combination. Intimidate users such as Incineroar and Landorus-T can also be problematic, as they dampen Ogerpon-W's damage output despite its positive type matchup into them. Ogerpon-W is forced into Tera Water, but it uniquely gives Ogerpon-W a useful Special Defense boost, helping against Pokemon like Gholdengo and Tornadus.

Notable Partners

Intimidate Answers: Pokemon that can take advantage of Intimidate like Galarian Zapdos and Kingambit or Pokemon that can block it like Dragonite make for good partners, as they can prevent Ogerpon-W's damage output from being lowered. When alongside these Intimidate answers, Ogerpon-W can utilize its good matchup into Intimidate users such as Landorus-T and Incineroar and check them properly.

Physical Attackers: Ogerpon-W is good with a lot of physical attackers such as Chien Pao, Iron Hands, and Ursaluna. Ogerpon-W can pass them Swords Dance and help them set up with Follow Me or utilize its strong offensive synergy with these teammates, such as Chien Pao beating the Grass- and Dragon-types that Ogerpon-W struggles with, Ogerpon-W beating Landorus for Iron Hands and Iron Hands beating Tornadus in return, and Ursaluna beating Dragonite for Ogerpon-W. Additionally, Chien-Pao provides Sword of Ruin, making the duo very obnoxious to switch into considering the type synergy between them, as well as making Ivy Cudgel more of a threat against Incineroar.

Water-weak Pokemon Teammates such as Heatran, Ting-Lu, Glimmora, and both Landorus formes appreciate the Water immunity that Ogerpon-W grants to its team. Follow Me can enable Substitute users like Landorus and Heatran, while Heatran can check Rillaboom, Sinistcha, and Amoonguss. Glimmora can provide entry hazard support to chip down would-be checks to Ogerpon-W, as well as check Flying-types like Tornadus and Dragonite that would otherwise cause problems.

Trick Room Setters Pokemon like Porygon2 and Diancie benefit from Ogerpon-W’s ability to redirect attacks that would otherwise threaten them, allowing them to set up Trick Room more easily. These teammates also have additional synergies, such as Porygon2 passing Download and Diancie passing Clear Body, as well as Ogerpon-W providing Diancie with a Water immunity.

Swords Dance.description: Fantastic STAB coverage, a solid Speed tier, and good coverage options all make Ogerpon-W a force to be reckoned with, being able to shatter most of the tier's physical walls such as Corviknight, Gholdengo, and Mandibuzz after a Swords Dance. Power Whip packs more of a punch, letting it OHKO RegenVest Manaphy without a Swords Dance boost, while Horn Leech grants it more longevity. Knock Off lets it threaten Desolate Land users such as Iron Moth, Ceruledge, and Heatran, while Play Rough picks off Dragon-types such as Roaring Moon, Dragonite, and Latios. Trailblaze enables Ogerpon-W to act as more of a sweeper, letting it outspeed threats such as Iron Boulder, Chien-Pao, and Deoxys-S, while Spikes can be used to help chip down Hisuian Goodra and other walls for its teammates. Ogerpon-W pairs well with fast cleaners such as Iron Boulder and Choice Scarf Roaring Moon, as they appreciate its ability to pressure Fluffy users such as Corviknight and Great Tusk thanks to Ivy Cudgel not making contact. In spite of its solid speed, Ogerpon-W is still threatened by faster targets such as Chien-Pao, Choice Scarf Azelf, and Roaring Moon, making defensive pivots such as Corviknight and Swampert crucial in order to bring it in safely.

All-Out Attacker.description: Ogerpon-W is a threatening wallbreaker thanks to its good stats and incredible movepool, featuring high Base Power STAB moves and strong coverage options. Power Whip is the standard Grass-type STAB move of choice due to its power, but Horn Leech can be used to avoid missing and provide Ogerpon-W with healing. Knock Off can hinder switch-ins like Intimidate Corviknight and Dragonite. Play Rough stops Dragonite from being a safe switch-in, as well as surprising Roaring Moon that try to switch in with an OHKO. U-turn allows Ogerpon-W to pivot out on bad matchups like the aforementioned Intimidate Corviknight and Dragonite. Stomping Tantrum hits Water-immune foes such as Water Absorb Heatran and Desolate Land Iron Moth and Ceruledge. Primordial Sea boosts Ogerpon-W's Ivy Cudgel to absurd levels, consistently 2HKOing non-Intimidate Corviknight while also giving Ogerpon-W a Fire immunity. Sword of Ruin is an alternative option to boost the power of all of Ogerpon-W's moves, notably OHKOing physically defensive Manaphy with Power Whip. Ogerpon-W pairs well with teammates like Zamazenta and Iron Boulder that can break through non-Fluffy Corviknight. It also appreciates Stealth Rock setters like Great Tusk and Scream Tail, as they discourage Pokemon like Dragonite from switching in and help chip down defensive Pokemon. While Ogerpon-W's Speed tier is good, it can still get easily revenge killed by Pokemon like Roaring Moon, Deoxys-S, and Zamazenta, so a strong defensive core featuring teammates such as Manaphy and Corviknight is appreciated. Ogerpon-W struggles with switching in safely, so it appreciates slow pivots like the aforementioned Corviknight and Manaphy.

Offensive Utility.description:
• Ivy Cudgel deals strong damage against the majority of the metagame and allows Ogerpon-W to hit common targets including Landorus, Diancie, Incineroar, and Chi-Yu super effectively.

  • Power Whip threatens potential OHKOs on Ursaluna and Diancie. Horn Leech is a reliable and accurate alternative that allows Ogerpon-W to recuperate its health, which is useful in maintaining its longevity.

  • Alternatively, Grass-type moves can be dropped in favor of some alternative options to serve the team's needs. Ogerpon-W can run Play Rough to enable it to OHKO Roaring Moon, which otherwise resists its STAB coverage, as well as pressure damage onto Raging Bolt and Kyurem. Encore is a disruptive option that can be used to facilitate setup opportunities for Ogerpon-W’s partners.

  • Follow Me allows Ogerpon-W to support its teammates by redirecting single target attacks from opposing Pokemon, including Earth Power from Landorus as well as status moves such as Spore from Amoonguss.

  • Spiky Shield punishes a number of contact damaging attacks that may be directed into Ogerpon-W, breaking the Focus Sash of Pokemon like Chien-Pao and punishing attempted Breaking Swipe from Gouging Fire and Roaring Moon.

  • Maximum Speed EVs allow Ogerpon to at least Speed tie the crowded base 110 Speed tier with opposing Ogerpon formes as well as outspeed Alolan Ninetales, Landorus, and non-Choice Scarf Chi-Yu. The bulk investment ensures that Ogerpon-W is not OHKOed by Tornadus's Bleakwind Storm, and the given Attack investment offers it a favorable roll to OHKO bulky Landorus.

  • Terastallization lets Ogerpon-W lose its weakness to Bleakwind Storm from Tornadus, Gunk Shot from Okidogi, and Sludge Bomb from Landorus. This also allows it to take Fire-type attacks, in particular from Chi-Yu, and turns Assault Vest Kyurem's Freeze-Dry from an OHKO to a favorable roll to not 2HKO.

  • Ogerpon-W is a versatile offensive support option that is useful on a number of team compositions. In particular, setup Pokemon, including Nasty Plot Gholdengo and Calm Mind Raging Bolt, appreciate Ogerpon-W’s Follow Me to redirect opposing attacks, facilitating opportunities to boost their stats. Ogerpon-W is able to offensively threaten Landorus, which checks both Gholdengo and Raging Bolt, and it is able to threaten Chi-Yu and Incineroar, which check Gholdengo.

  • Ogerpon-W struggles with common Grass-types like Rillaboom, Sinistcha, and Amoonguss, which resist its STAB coverage and deal respectable damage in return, especially to Terastallized Ogerpon-W. Ogerpon-W also loses its immunity to Rage Powder and Spore when Terastallized. Partners like Tornadus and Chien-Pao offensively threaten these Grass-types while additionally supporting Ogerpon-W with speed control in Prankster Tailwind and bolstering its damage with Sword of Ruin, respectively.

  • Dragon-types, including Raging Bolt and Kyurem, resist Ogerpon-W's offensive coverage and deal significant damage in return. Breaking Swipe from Roaring Moon and Gouging Fire bypasses Ogerpon-W's ability to redirect damage while also lowering its Attack. Partners like Roaring Moon can offer fast Tailwind support and coverage for opposing Dragon-types and physical attackers including Iron Hands, which threatens significant damage against Terastallized Ogerpon-W.

Swords Dance (Water).description: Ogerpon-W is a strong wallbreaker on Water teams by virtue of its great Attack, which can be further boosted by Swords Dance; great Speed; a unique resistance to Ground, improving that matchup; and a selection of coverage options it can choose from. Horn Leech not only lets Ogerpon-W recover HP, but it also targets the likes of Urshifu-R, Slowbro, and Mantine, which can otherwise shrug off an Ivy Cudgel. At +2, Play Rough targets Dragon- and Fighting-types such as Kyurem, Kommo-o, and Iron Hands. After a Swords Dance boost, Superpower is great against Steel-types like Hisuian Goodra, Archaludon, and Ferrothorn; unboosted, it also OHKOes Kyurem after Stealth Rock chip. Taunt shuts down passive walls such as Toxapex, Gastrodon, and Thunder Wave Archaludon to force them out and get the opportunity to set up, while after a boost, Knock Off targets Sinistcha. Swampert provides entry hazard support to help Ogerpon-W wallbreak and pivoting with Flip Turn; its Electric immunity improves the matchup against the type, handling the likes of Zeraora, Iron Hands, and Regieleki. Empoleon and Pelipper remove hazards in Defog so that Ogerpon-W does not get worn down. Additionally, Empoleon threatens Fairy-types such as Tapu Lele and Alolan Ninetales, as well as Tornadus-T and Kyurem, while Pelipper sets up rain to boost Ogerpon-W's Ivy Cudgel, handles Grass-types like Meowscarada and Mega Venusaur, and brings it in safely with U-turn. In return, Empoleon appreciates Ogerpon-W handling Ground-types such as Great Tusk and the Landorus formes, while Pelipper appreciates the removal of Hisuian Arcanine, the Landorus formes, and Gholdengo. Choice Scarf Tapu Fini, with its amazing bulk, handles fast Fighting- and Dragon-types like Iron Valiant, Mega Lopunny, and Dragon Dance Roaring Moon and can shift its Choice Scarf to walls like Toxapex and Clodsire with Trick so Ogerpon-W can handle them more easily. Choice Specs Greninja, with its colorful coverage boosted by Protean, handles a multitude of threats like opposing Ogerpon-W, Tapu Bulu, and Mega Venusaur. When paired with Pelipper, Ogerpon-W's wallbreaking opens up the door for rain-boosted sweepers and cleaners such as Mega Swampert and Barraskewda.

Swords Dance (Grass).description: This is the sample set before we work on new analyses. This will be updated as the metagame continues to develop. Stay tuned!

Swords Dance (Fire).description:
Swords Dance Ogerpon-H is the big dog of Fire teams courtesy of Hearthflame Mask increasing its damage output, its part Grass typing allowing it to fire back in the Water and Ground matchups, and Mold Breaker ignoring abilities from threatening foes such as Dondozo and Heatran. After a Swords Dance, Ivy Cudgel allows Ogerpon-H to easily break through bulky foes such as Hisuian Goodra, Clodsire, and Life Orb Landorus. Horn Leech provides the utility to regenerate health while exerting offensive pressure, letting Ogerpon-H threaten Mamoswine, Hisuian Samurott, and Urshifu-R after a boost. At +2, Play Rough improves the matchup against Dragon-types, threatening an OHKO on Garchomp and Dragonite.

Ninetales and Torkoal are the most prominent partners of Ogerpon-H, as they set sun, allowing its Ivy Cudgel to OHKO foes like Life Orb Landorus and OHKO bulky foes such as Gliscor, Iron Hands, and Galarian Weezing after a Swords Dance. Ninetales provides utility by burning foes such as Urshifu-R and non-Choice Scarf Great Tusk with Will-O-Wisp, using Healing Wish to give Ogerpon-H another chance to sweep once it has been chipped down, and using Encore to allow Ogerpon-H to set up on Pokemon locked into a move such as Sableye, Pecharunt, and Toxapex. On the other hand, Torkoal provides entry hazard control through Rapid Spin, threatens Roaring Moon with Body Press while tanking its moves, and sets up Stealth Rock to chip foes such as Alolan Muk and Spectrier, allowing Ogerpon-H to sweep more easily. Cinderace is another ally that assists with hazard removal due to Court Change, which covers for Ogerpon-H's weakness to hazards. It also serves as a fast pivot via U-turn and provides priority in Sucker Punch, removing chipped foes. Heatran, while being a temporary Ground immunity with the help of Air Balloon, also traps and removes Toxapex, which is a big annoyance to Ogerpon-H. It also notably OHKOes Flutter Mane with Heavy Slam, which can threaten a chipped Ogerpon-H with Power Gem. Volcarona and Ceruledge are fellow setup sweepers that appreciate Ogerpon-H's ability to weaken threatening foes such as Hisuian Goodra and Ting-Lu so they can clean up late-game.

Swords Dance (Grass).description:
Ogerpon-H is an invaluable asset on Grass teams. With Swords Dance and the damage bonus from Hearthflame Mask, Ogerpon-H serves as a strong wallbreaker, and its Fire typing also gives Grass teams a hand in both the Steel and Ice matchups. Aside from this, its access to Mold Breaker allows it to bypass abilities such as Heatran's Flash Fire, Dondozo's Unaware, and Dragonite's Multiscale. With Hearthflame Mask, Ivy Cudgel turns into a powerful Fire-type move, and combined with its Speed, Ogerpon-H is able to beat the likes of Alolan Ninetales and Corviknight before a Swords Dance boost, as well as Hisuian Goodra after. Horn Leech grants Ogerpon-H some form of longevity. Play Rough allows Ogerpon-H to threaten the likes of Kommo-o, and after a Swords Dance Boost, it can 2HKO Dragonite. Alternatively, Trailblaze gives Ogerpon-H potential as a sweeper. After one Trailblaze, Ogerpon-H outspeeds the likes of Weavile and Choice Specs Greninja. Lastly, with Zen Headbutt, Ogerpon-H can surprise would-be switch-ins such as Toxapex, Clodsire, and Iron Moth.

Entry hazard support from the likes of Brambleghast and Toedscruel is appreciated to wear down foes into OHKO range from Ogerpon-H. Notably, Ogerpon-H has a chance to OHKO Bulky Bisharp with one layer of Spikes. The two of them also have access to Rapid Spin, allowing them to remove hazards so that Ogerpon-H has more opportunities to switch in without getting worn down. Toedscruel can also take Fire-type attacks from Iron Moth and KO it back, while Brambleghast can switch into a predicted Flying-type move as well as revenge kill Flutter Mane with Shadow Sneak. Amoonguss is another great teammate, as its bulk and access to Spore allow it to either incapacitate or force out foes such as Dragonite. Choice Scarf Meowscarada outspeeds and removes potential threats to Ogerpon-H like Spectrier and faster Dragon-types, and it can bring Ogerpon-H in safely. Ogerpon-H's wallbreaking enables sweepers such as Hisuian Liligant and Torterra. In return, the two of them can handle foes Ogerpon-H struggles with, such as Landorus for the former and Toxapex for the latter. Rillaboom is a great revenge killer and wallbreaker to pair with Ogerpon-H, as with Grassy Glide, it can remove faster threats such as Flutter Mane and Hoopa-U. Aside from this, Rillaboom also provides Grassy Terrain to boost the power of Ogerpon-H's Grass-type moves. In return, Rillaboom appreciates Ogerpon-H removing foes Rillaboom struggles with such as Corviknight and Articuno. Breloom is another great teammate, as due to its Fighting typing and access to Mach Punch, it can easily deal with Greninja. Lastly, Abomasnow has some niche as a teammate, as it can set up Aurora Veil to make Ogerpon-H and its teammates harder to KO.

Offensive Redirector.description:
Set Details

  • With its immunity to Spore from Amoonguss and Brute Bonnet, Ogerpon-H is able to use Follow Me to support its allies while offensively putting pressure on common threats such as Rillaboom and Urshifu-R. Additionally, Ogerpon-H matches up well offensively into Calyrex-I and Zacian-C.
  • Wood Hammer is the most common Grass-type STAB option on Ogerpon-H for its high and consistent damage output, notably OHKOing Urshifu-R. Grassy Glide can be used as a niche option when paired with Rillaboom for powerful priority in Grassy Terrain.
  • This EV spread allows Ogerpon to almost always take a Tera Water Surging Strikes from Urshifu-R, a +1 Glacial Lance from most Calyrex-I, or a Choice Specs Draco Meteor from Timid Miraidon under Light Screen. It is also able to OHKO Rillaboom with Ivy Cudgel, outspeed Modest Landorus-I, and pick up an OHKO on both Calyrex formes with +1 Attack Tera Fire Ivy Cudgel.

Teambuilding

  • Incineroar can be very problematic for Ogerpon-H, reducing its damage output with Intimidate and Parting Shot and resisting its STAB moves. Other Dragon- and Fire-types such as Koraidon and Chi-Yu can also threaten Ogerpon-H while resisting its STAB combination.
  • Ogerpon-C can outspeed and threaten Ogerpon-H with an OHKO with Ivy Cudgel, while other fast threats, including Calyrex-S and Miraidon, can outspeed and threaten it with huge damage. Ogerpon-H can also struggle against powerful spread damage from Calyrex-I and Terapagos, which ignore Follow Me.
  • Ogerpon-H pairs well with Calyrex-S and Zamazenta-C, as it can protect both from powerful attacks and notably allows Calyrex-S to set up, while Calyrex-S is able to threaten Koraidon and Zamazenta threatens Incineroar for Ogerpon-H. Miraidon also benefits greatly from redirection from Ogerpon-H as well as its ability to threaten Rillaboom with an OHKO using Ivy Cudgel, while Miraidon can threaten Incineroar and Dragon-types for Ogerpon-H.
  • Calyrex-I also greatly appreciates redirection support, helping it to set up Trick Room and sweep, while Calyrex-I can hit the Dragon-types that can stifle Ogerpon-H's offense and allows Ogerpon-H to threaten faster foes with Trick Room.
  • Urshifu-R is a strong partner for Ogerpon-H, as together, they form a potent offensive core. Urshifu-R appreciates redirection to safely dish out huge damage, while it can threaten Incineroar and, with Tera Water, KO Ogerpon-C and Calyrex-S for Ogerpon-H. Rillaboom is another strong partner, as Follow Me support allows for it to safely pivot with U-turn while Rillaboom's Grassy Terrain bolsters Ogerpon-H's Grass-type moves and provides priority to Ogerpon-H's Grassy Glide.

Ogerpon-H is a spectacular Pokemon in Regulation G thanks to Follow Me combined with its offensive presence. Its STAB combination allows it to threaten many metagame staples, such as Rillaboom, Amoonguss, Calyrex-I, and Urshifu-R, for massive damage. Ogerpon-H prefers to use Wood Hammer to ensure OHKOs on Urshifu-R and bulky Kyogre; however, Horn Leech is used alongside the defensive sets for more survivability while still 2HKOing the aforementioned Water-types. Grassy Glide is a niche option, providing Ogerpon-H with a powerful priority move alongside Rillaboom and allowing Ogerpon-H to attack faster threats like Calyrex-S and Choice Scarf Urshifu-R before they move. The HP and Defense investment ensures that Ogerpon-H survives Tera Stellar Icicle Crash from Chien-Pao and almost always lives Tera Water Surging Strikes from Urshifu-R. The Speed EVs allow Ogerpon-H to outspeed Modest Landorus, and the rest is to maximize Attack. Ogerpon-H can use a much bulkier EV spread of 220 HP / 12 Atk / 252 Def / 4 SpD / 20 Spe with an Impish nature, which allows it to avoid the 2HKO from Chien-Pao's Ice Spinner, Calyrex-I's Glacial Lance, and Iron Hands's Quark Drive-boosted Drain Punch as well as surviving +1 Tera Fire Ivy Cudgel from opposing Ogerpon-H. The Speed investment allows Ogerpon-H to outspeed neutral-natured base 80 Speed Pokemon such as Regidrago.

Ogerpon-H especially struggles with Incineroar, which stomachs its attacks and weakens it with Intimidate and Parting Shot. Dragon-types like Raging Bolt and Roaring Moon are also problematic, taking its attacks and threatening massive damage with Draco Meteor and Acrobatics respectively. Landorus can also be threatening thanks to being able to threaten Ogerpon-H before and after it Terastallizes with Sludge Bomb and Earth Power respectively. Urshifu-R and Landorus make for excellent partners, as they threaten OHKOs on many of the aforementioned Pokemon with their STAB moves. The two also appreciate Ogerpon-H's support, as it can protect them from threatening Pokemon like Rillaboom and Chien-Pao with Follow Me. Miraidon makes excellent use of Ogerpon-H, as it appreciates Ogerpon-H threatening common checks like Rillaboom and Zacian-C with Ivy Cudgel and stomaching their attacks with Follow Me. Calyrex-I is another Restricted Pokemon that works well with Ogerpon-H, as it threatens Landorus and Raging Bolt with Glacial Lance. Calyrex-I has an easier time setting up Trick Room and dealing with disruptive status moves such as Amoonguss's Spore and Incineroar's Will-O-Wisp thanks to Ogerpon-H's Follow Me.
